events.author: Test summary of Renovate dashboard
events.text: GitHub Issue #2119 is an automatically generated Renovate Dependency Dashboard for the WALA repository. Several dependency updates are awaiting status checks, including com.android.tools:r8 v9.5.29, dependency-analysis v3.20.2, actions/setup-java v6.2.0, and the Java devcontainer Docker image. Open update pull requests include #2152 and #2153. The Eclipse JDT dependency update is blocked by a previously closed pull request #2121. The issue remains open and tracks outstanding dependency maintenance work.
